hook: Pay in four. Zero interest. Just split it. Buy now, pay later is now at almost every checkout, even for groceries and takeout. In this video I look at it from three angles: the numbers (10x growth in two years, loan stacking, phantom debt), the psychology (why $50 x 4 feels cheaper than $200) and the playbook (the golden rule, and how to get out if you're juggling several plans).
